compounddef.initializer: template<typename T> concept hgl::traits::c_hypergraph_repr_tag = c_hypergraph_incidence_list_repr<T> or c_hypergraph_incidence_matrix_repr<T>

briefdescription.para: Validates if a type is one of the defined hypergraph representation tags.

detaileddescription.para: This concept is used to constrain template parameters that are expected to be specific hypergraph representation tags, ensuring type safety and clear intent in template usage.

The valid tags include:
repr::list_t: Represents a standard incidence list representation.
repr::flat_list_t: Represents a flattened incidence list representation.
repr::matrix_t: Represents a standard incidence matrix representation.
repr::flat_matrix_t: Represents a flattened incidence matrix representation.

parameterdescription.para: The type to evaluate against the concept.
